value.zh: 修读课程：已修读语料库语言学，人工智能基础、 语言数据科学理论与Python应用，具备一定的编程以及文本处理基础。目前正在学习语言统计和语言智能与认知、语言学概论等课程，进一步学习语言数据分析方法。
value.en: Coursework: Completed Corpus Linguistics, Fundamentals of Artificial Intelligence, and Language Data Science: Theory and Python Applications, building a foundation in programming and text processing. Currently studying Statistics for Language Studies, Language Intelligence and Cognition, and Introduction to Linguistics to further develop language data analysis skills.

value.zh: 具备Python编程基础，能够使用Trae此类辅助编程工具，熟悉大语言模型和AI工具的使用；能够使用ELAN进行语言材料标注；学习过SPSS的使用方法；对Gephi网络分析与可视化有基本了解
value.en: Foundational Python programming skills; able to use AI-assisted coding tools such as Trae and familiar with large language models and other AI tools. Experienced with ELAN for linguistic annotation, trained in the use of SPSS, and familiar with the basics of network analysis and visualization in Gephi.

value.en: Collaborated with two classmates to build a large-language-model-powered interactive interface with Gradio and to design and complete a simple interactive puzzle game using MediaPipe.

value.en: German major with systematic training in German language and linguistics, with the ability to read and analyze German-language texts.

value.zh: 作为德语专业学生，我希望将自己的德语语言及语言学背景与数字方法结合，进一步探索跨语言、跨文化的数字人文研究。相比单纯关注技术本身，我认为更重要的是将技术方法应用于具体的语言与人文研究问题，例如借助语料库、自然语言处理、大语言模型以及统计方法，对较大规模的文本进行分析，从中观察和解释语言、文学与文化现象。目前我的技术能力仍处于不断学习和积累的阶段，但我很乐于接触新的研究方法和工具，也愿意稳定投入时间学习研究相关内容。
value.en: As a German major, I hope to combine my background in German and linguistics with digital methods and further explore cross-linguistic and cross-cultural research in the digital humanities. Rather than focusing on technology alone, I am especially interested in applying computational methods to concrete questions in language and the humanities—for example, using corpora, natural language processing, large language models, and statistical methods to analyze texts at scale and interpret linguistic, literary, and cultural phenomena. My technical skills are still developing, but I am eager to learn new research methods and tools and committed to steadily building the knowledge required for this work.
